description: This file contains utility functions for text comparison, debugging, and table validation, primarily used within a testing or scripting context in a larger project.

methods.name: print_differences
methods.description: Prints differences between actual and expected text, with optional debug output.

methods.description: Context manager that prints differences if an assertion fails.
